module e203_clkgate (
  input   clk_in,
  input   test_mode,
  input   clock_en,
  output  clk_out
);

`ifdef FPGA_SOURCE//{
    // In the FPGA, the clock gating is just pass through
    assign clk_out = clk_in;
`endif//}

`ifndef FPGA_SOURCE//{

reg enb;

always@(*)
  if (!clk_in)
    enb = (clock_en | test_mode);

assign clk_out = enb & clk_in;

`endif//}

endmodule
